newsitem.title: UK: Lehman Brothers sets warrants on German companies.
newsitem.headline: Lehman Brothers sets warrants on German companies.

text.p: Lehman Brothers Finance S.A. has issued eight million warrants, in eight equal tranches of American-style call warrants, on German companies, lead manager Lehman Brothers Bankhaus AG said.
There are two tranches each on Daimler, Karstadt, Porsche and Volkswagen.
